w4_facts.source: Karton et al. 2009, abstract and Table V
w4_facts.caution: TAE0 includes zero-point energy; do not confuse with bottom-of-well TAEe or fragmentation energy. Rounded published values, not new computed values.

spectroscopy_facts.source: Xu et al. 1997 section IV B and Table II
spectroscopy_facts.other_singlet_conflict: 1Sigma_g+ is tentatively 0.50 +/- 0.02 eV in section IV B/Table II but 0.93 eV in Table V. This review preserves the conflict and does not select that value.
spectroscopy_facts.diagnostic_scope: Only the isolated electronic Boltzmann weight (degeneracy2 against ground-triplet3); no rovibrational states, cyclic isomer or completeness estimate.

sources.title: Photoelectron spectroscopy of C4-, C6-, and C8-
sources.authors: C. Xu, G. R. Burton, T. R. Taylor, D. M. Neumark
sources.access: Full author-hosted published PDF downloaded; sectionsIII/IVB, TablesII/V and C4 spectral discussion inspected; TableV visually checked.
findings: Linear C4 has triplet3Sigma_g^- ground state; first1Delta_g at0.332+/-0.015eV.
Low bending frequencynu4=323+/-50cm^-1 and stretch nu1=2057+/-50cm^-1 are reported for the triplet.
1Sigma_g+ entry conflict between TableV and TableII/body retained; electronic energies are not a complete hot partition function.

sources.title: Atomization energies of the carbon clusters Cn(n=2-10) revisited by means of W4 theory as well as density functional, Gn, and CBS methods
sources.authors: A. Karton, A. Tarnopolsky, J. M. L. Martin
sources.access: Full author manuscript downloaded; methods, C4 discussion, abstract and energy tables inspected.
findings: Separate lineartriplet and cyclicsinglet TAE0 values429.16 and430.09kcal/mol.
Post-CCSD(T) corrections affect the small isomer splitting; neither formula nor spin multiplicity alone identifies an equilibrium mixture.
The published high-level result is a candidate energy reference, not a full1500-4000K thermochemical model.
